tool_suggestions.title: Customer Relationship Health Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a dashboard that visualizes the health of customer relationships based on existing data, allowing internal teams to identify which relationships need attention.
features: Visualize relationship scores and health trends over time
Display recent communication activities with sentiment analysis
Show upcoming meetings and reminders related to key contacts
Highlight contacts with recent job changes or notable activities

tool_suggestions.title: Internal Contact Tagging System
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a tagging system for internal teams to categorize and manage contacts effectively, enabling quick access to strategic relationship data.
features: Tag and categorize contacts based on relationship type or priority
Filter and search contacts by tags and relationship score
View detailed contact information and recent interactions
Assign tags to multiple contacts in bulk

tool_suggestions.title: Meeting Effectiveness Tracker
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool that assesses and tracks the effectiveness of meetings, helping internal teams optimize meeting strategies and improve outcomes.
features: Analyze meeting participation and response rates
Track meeting frequency and duration per contact or team
Visualize meeting outcomes based on collected feedback
Provide insights on meeting types associated with successful outcomes
